blocks.content: Human rights are basic rights inherent to all human beings regardless of caste, religion, gender, or nationality. They include the right to life, freedom from torture, equality before law, and freedom of expression.
Human rights are basic rights inherent to all human beings regardless of caste, religion, gender, or nationality.

items: Exams frequently ask about the universality of Human Rights (inherent regardless of caste, religion, gender, or nationality).
Note that both civil liberties (freedom of expression) and legal protections (equality before law) are essential components of human rights.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Human rights are fundamental rights inherent to every human being.
They apply universally without discrimination based on caste, religion, gender, or nationality.
Core protections include the right to life and absolute freedom from torture.
Essential freedoms encompass equality before the law and freedom of expression.
